# B2 full validation: Gate C review

**Researcher B2 review accepted: 3 November 2026.** Accepted findings: B2 real has lowest horizon-1 MAE (not significant), trails boosting from horizon 6 with longer-horizon overprediction; scaling leaves no established graph forecast value, and learned graph was excluded at screen; removing installed base worsens MAE/MASE at every reported outcome (minimum Holm p 0.056), consistent with original B.

All retained conditions complete. Final test sealed. Main model: **real**. Screen choice and inclusion were fixed before campaign fitting. No refits in this evaluation. Validation p-values are descriptive after model development.

## Metrics and seed spread

Equal area/origin/seed losses, not seed-ensemble forecasts. MAE primary; seasonal MASE unitless; RMSE roots pooled squared error. Monthly units systems/area/month, total systems/area/window. Dynamic maturity terciles and pooled zero-scale fallback unchanged.

Researcher B2 review accepted on 3 November 2026. The separately authorised next work is CPU-only ensemble/combination analysis; final test remains sealed.

## Verified completion and review summary

3 November 2026. All four conditions and the combined evaluation are verified complete. **B2 Gate C review accepted by the researcher on 3 November 2026.** The accepted earlier B Gate C is unchanged. No further model run is needed now.

Real has lower MAE than shuffled at all four reported outcomes, but none of the 20 predeclared Holm-adjusted tests is below 0.05. Real beats no graph on MAE at horizon 1 only; no graph is lower at horizons 6, 12 and total. These results do not establish a geographic forecast gain for B2.

Real has lower MAE than both boosting baselines at horizon 1; both boosting baselines are lower at horizons 6, 12 and total. Real has lower MASE than own-lag boosting at all four outcomes. Real beats seasonal naive on MAE at horizons 1 and 6, but not at 12 or total.

Removing installed base worsens MAE and MASE at all four reported outcomes. The closest adjusted comparison is real versus without-base at horizon 1, Holm p 0.0557723, which remains above 0.05. Lack of significance is not equivalence. Validation-based configuration/epoch/model selection, 36 overlapping origins and three fixed seeds limit inference. No individual behavioural mechanism is identified.
